hens_rule_text: Keeping chickens or other fowl is banned citywide except under a license issued by the Chief of Police; licensed keepers may keep up to 30 fowl within an open area of 240 sq ft.
permit_notes: A license from the Chief of Police (Rochester Police Department) is required to keep any fowl; the code frames chicken-keeping as generally prohibited with a licensing exception, rather than allowed by right.
setback_notes: No live poultry may be kept in a cellar or any part of a dwelling or building used for continuous daily human occupation; a secondary source cites a 25 ft setback from adjacent dwellings, but this was not confirmed in the sections read directly.
coop_rules: Each fowl needs at least 4 sq ft of floor space in the coop plus at least 4 sq ft of runway space; coops, runways and premises must be kept clean and sanitary at all times and are subject to inspection.
zoning_notes: Rules sit in Municipal Code Chapter 30 (Animals), Article I: Sec. 30-13 Poultry Raising Prohibited (the general ban with the licensing exception), Sec. 30-15/30-16 Licenses and Fee, and Sec. 30-19 Regulations Relating to Fowl (the space and housing standards).
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.

sources.name: City of Rochester, NY Code, Chapter 30 Animals, Article I Permitted Animals (via Internet Archive copy of eCode360)

research_notes: ecode360.com returns a Cloudflare block from this machine; a July 2023 Internet Archive snapshot of the article's table of contents confirmed the section numbers and titles (Sec. 30-13 Poultry Raising Prohibited, Sec. 30-19 Regulations Relating to Fowl), and search-result extracts quoted the operative text directly, including the license requirement, the 30-fowl/240-sq-ft cap, the 4 sq ft floor plus 4 sq ft runway standard, and the rule that a male fowl must be removed once the Chief of Police gives notice it is a nuisance. The specific full text of Sec. 30-19 and any coop setback distance were not read directly, so those points are lower confidence.
